items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry, sensitive-feeling skin comfortable.
A soothing centella gel to calm the look of redness and warmth-prone skin.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, hydrated skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 that is gentle on sensitive skin and helps shield fair skin from sun and heat exposure.

response.routine_note: Cleanse with lukewarm water, then layer the gel and moisturizer morning and night, adding the mineral SPF last in the morning, and skip scrubs, strong acids and retinoids for now. Because going red with warmth or wine is something a dermatologist is best placed to look at, we suggest booking a visit rather than adding more products.
